title: "A lot of texts": flag it, offer fewer step days, then the feedback reply when they'd rather keep the days
origin: Spec #13 (metrics), Should: back-off requests are flagged and answered with what the app can do

history.text: Kalimera Jordan! 30 minutes around the park at 6 today. What's the plan to make it happen?

plan.reason: Running every day builds the habit fast.

testerLines: this is a lot of texts lol
nah I want to keep running every day, it's just a lot of messages
whatWentWrong: New case, not a past mistake: the back-off path.
shouldHaveHappened: A back_off flag is saved. ZOH first offers fewer step days (at least 3 a week) or a lighter stretch, in a line, without guilt. When they say they want to keep every day, it takes that as feedback: thanks them and says the team's on it (in its own words), and doesn't promise or offer fewer texts or any other change. It isn't a stop or a pause.
